Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a child support performance award.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating a child support performance award;adding a new section to chapter 26.18 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Washington spends significant resources eachyear on child support services. The legislature intends to acknowledgeparents who are fulfilling their noncustodial child support obligation.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall: (1) Issue to an obligor or noncustodial parent a formal accountingor financial statement, documenting payments and credits for childsupport, and if applicable, spousal maintenance, at the end of eachyear, or upon request; (2) Award a certificate to those who are in satisfactory orexcellent compliance with their noncustodial financial obligations, atthe end of each year, or upon request; and (3) Keep a record of the certificate, which may be admitted at the p. 1 SB 6200court's discretion, as evidence in civil proceedings involving thenoncustodial parent.
